identifier_namespace: HM Revenue & Customs Humber Freeport tax site
evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official Humber Freeport tax-site page lists a document labelled Goole and states that Freeport tax sites are designated and recognised in law as geographical areas where businesses can benefit from tax reliefs to bring investment, trade and jobs to regenerate regions. It states that the Goole tax site was designated with effect from 13 February 2024, and the update history says a map was added on 18 January 2024 to reflect boundary changes at the Goole tax site.

field_evidence.boundary_update_note: A map was added on 18 January 2024 to reflect boundary changes at the Goole tax site.
field_evidence.stated_policy_purpose: tax reliefs to bring investment, trade and jobs to regenerate regions

binding_method: legally designated national Freeport tax-site geography plus official boundary-map publication; canonical parcel spatial binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: The official GOV.UK publication page was accessed as public no-login web text; raw bytes of the linked Goole PDF map were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.
